findings.label: Phone skeleton omits the phone Message row
findings.detail: PhoneStackSkeleton reserves nothing for the md:hidden MessageSellerButton at mt-snug under the seller row, so the description may shift about 44px on swap for signed-in buyers. Not introduced by this diff; consider reserving mt-snug h-10.

findings.label: Fee note shown to owners and unavailable listings
findings.detail: ListingFeeNote is now gated only on !isShopfront (was !isOwner on desktop, showTrust on phone). This is deliberate per the plan and display-only, because the popover was already universal.

findings.label: Binder copy says 'Multiple items'
findings.detail: The product rules ask for 'binder or bulk listing'. The plan kept 'Multiple items' to match ItemCard/ItemForm, and 'nothing is held' is now on the page. A copy change app-wide is a separate user decision.

findings.label: Seller name fallback differs between layouts
findings.detail: ListingDetailStack passes 'Seller' and ListingDesktopPane passes 'Unknown seller' into the shared ListingSellerRow. Pick one.

findings.label: Visual check not done
findings.detail: No dev server ran, so the rendered pane and the skeleton-to-page swap are unverified in a browser. The user should eyeball the available, sold, binder and owner states at >=1024px and ~390px.
